description: Implementation of rx::VertexArray11 class for Direct3D 11 rendering in ANGLE, managing vertex array state, synchronization, and index/attribute updates.

classes.name: VertexArray11
classes.description: Manages vertex array state, synchronization, and index/attribute updates for ANGLE's Direct3D 11 renderer.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes vertex array state based on dirty bits, updates attributes and buffers.

methods.name: syncStateForDraw
methods.description: Prepares state for drawing, updates index and attribute data as needed.

methods.name: updateElementArrayStorage
methods.description: Updates index buffer storage based on current indices and index type.

methods.name: updateVertexAttribStorage
methods.description: Updates storage type for a specific vertex attribute.

methods.name: hasActiveDynamicAttrib
methods.description: Checks if there are active dynamic attributes.

methods.name: updateDynamicAttribs
methods.description: Updates dynamic attributes for a range of vertices.

methods.name: markAllAttributeDivisorsForAdjustment
methods.description: Adjusts attribute divisors for multiple views.

methods.name: isCachedIndexInfoValid
methods.description: Checks if cached index data is valid.
